pkgs/go/validate_composite.go.note: C4 FIX: setElementKey now uses sorted map keys for deterministic serialization (was non-deterministic fmt.Sprintf("obj:%v", v)). Added imports for "sort" and "strings".

pkgs/go/validate_primitive.go.note: H5 FIX: coerceValue number now handles JS numeric prefixes: 0x (hex), 0b (binary), 0o (octal) before falling back to ParseFloat.

H4 FIX: Replaced fmt.Sprint in coerceValue string coercion with JS-compatible coerceToString helper. Handles nil→"null", bool→"true"/"false", arrays→comma-joined, maps→"[object Object]", int floats→no decimal.
H3 FIX: Split PrimUndef/PrimVoid into separate cases with distinct error messages. z.undefined() expects only undefined, z.void() accepts undefined or null.
H1 FIX: Added 3 missing ISO 8601 date formats to parseDateString: ms without tz (2006-01-02T15:04:05.000), space-separated (2006-01-02 15:04:05), ms with tz offset (2006-01-02T15:04:05.000-07:00).

pkgs/core/src/extract/resolver.ts.note: MED-3: resolveIdentifier delegates to lookupIdentifierIR to eliminate ~35 lines of duplicated logic (both methods did the same local + cross-file lookup with circular handling)

pkgs/core/src/ir/json.ts.note: MED-4: schemasToJson now warns via console.warn when duplicate schema names overwrite previous entries

pkgs/core/src/cast/ast.ts.note: MED-5: castObjectChain now warns via console.warn for unknown object-chain step names (e.g., .optional() on objects) instead of silently ignoring them

pkgs/core/src/cast/ast-utils.ts.note: MED-6: parseObjectLiteral now warns via console.warn when a computed property key can't be statically resolved (field skipped)

pkgs/core/src/number-formatter.ts.note: LOW-6: formatNumber now handles -0 (Object.is(value, -0) returns '-0') instead of String(-0) which returns '0'

pkgs/core/src/serializer.ts.note: LOW-4: generateModule returns empty string when no schemas were serialized (avoids orphan 'import { z } from zod;' with no exports)

pkgs/vite-plugin/src/index.ts.note: M4: defaultFilter no longer skips Type-suffixed names (dropping names like UserType, ProductType was too aggressive)
